# Vegetarian Lasagna Recipe from AllRecipes

I searched for "vegetarian lasagna" on AllRecipes and selected the **Vegetarian Four Cheese Lasagna** — it has the highest star rating among vegetarian lasagna options (4.6 ⭐) with the most ratings (243).

## Recipe Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Recipe Name** | Vegetarian Four Cheese Lasagna |
| **Rating** | 4.6 stars (243 ratings, 170 reviews) |
| **Prep Time** | 15 mins |
| **Cook Time** | 1 hr |
| **Total Time** | 1 hr 15 mins |
| **Servings** | 8 (1 - 9x13 dish) |
| **URL** | https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/21090/vegetarian-four-cheese-lasagna/ |

## Key Ingredients

1. 2 cups peeled and diced pumpkin
2. 1 eggplant, sliced into 1/2 inch rounds
3. 5 tomatoes
4. 1 pint ricotta cheese
5. 9 ounces crumbled feta cheese
6. ⅔ cup pesto
7. 2 eggs, beaten
8. Salt and pepper to taste
9. 1 (15 ounce) can tomato sauce
10. Fresh pasta sheets
11. 1 ⅓ cups shredded mozzarella cheese
12. 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese

**Recipe description (from AllRecipes):** "This is a mouth tingling recipe with ricotta, feta, eggplant, tomato, pesto, pumpkin, Parmesan and mozzarella." — submitted by Rosemary, updated February 1, 2025.
